attempted_claim: Let p>=3, K=Q_p, and let X/K be a genus-2 Mumford curve uniformized by a rank-two Schottky group with minimal Berkovich skeleton a theta metric graph Gamma and tropical Jacobian J(Gamma) with period matrix Q_Gamma from the cycle-length pairing. Decide by proof or rigorous counterexample: does there exist such an X over Q_p itself whose J(Gamma) is (2,2)-isogenous (not isometrically split) to a product of two tropical elliptic curves, witnessed by a pair of optimal tropical covers in the sense of Cobigo? Scope is all theta-skeleton Mumford curves over Q_p for odd p. A complete answer either gives explicit Schottky matrices over Q_p, computes Gamma and Q_Gamma, and certifies the (2,2)-isogeny with explicit optimal-cover witnesses and kernel, or proves that no theta skeleton from Q_p uniformization admits such a (2,2)-splitting (so (2,2)-splitting forces dumbbell type or non-Mumford uniformization).
